r1-handoff.finding: All handoff asks met: parallel_jobs.py adds frozen picklable TrainBacktestJob + module-level run_train_backtest; run_cycle resolves plan once and threads into all 3 loops; 3 builders fan out via run_jobs with input-order assembly; new test file + runner test updated with background plan.

r4-quality.title: Quality vs inherited rules
r4-quality.imperative: Does the change meet the inherited project/section rules? Append a check per rule. Record pass/fail with a finding.
r4-quality.finding: Meets inherited rules: DB-only (no FastF1/Jolpica import added; jobs carry db_path/db_root strings, workers build DatabaseManager per-call via _resolve_db_args); logging via getLogger not print; module-level spawn-safe workers; no mutable module-level state (frozen dataclass, plans passed as args); small composable fns (builders + _iter_loso_units single-source-of-order + extracted parsers); reuses existing run_jobs/resolve_resource_plan from utilization.py; explicit type hints on new public builders. Determinism: input-order assembly everywhere (dict-by-key for main, zip for LOSO, nested-order for calib).

r5-reconciliation.title: Reconciliation check
r5-reconciliation.imperative: Does the change diverge from the recorded architecture in a way Commander must reconcile? Record pass/fail; flag a triage candidate if out of scope.
r5-reconciliation.finding: No contract/schema divergence: report schema, run_config, and backtest numerics unchanged. New module parallel_jobs.py + new public builders (build_main/loso/calibration_train_backtest_jobs) are added structure; docs/architecture/index.md may warrant a gold_cycle entry update but that is Commander/Cartographer closeout scope for issue #356, not a G3 blocker. Flagged as low-sev observation.

q-order-args.title: Byte-identity: job order + args
q-order-args.imperative: Each loop builds its job list in the SAME order and SAME args as the prior nested iteration; outputs assembled in INPUT order. Read builders vs original loops. Record pass/fail.
q-order-args.finding: Verified all 3 builders vs HEAD originals field-by-field. MAIN: build_main_train_backtest_jobs iterates module_names same order, key=module_name, backtest fields (module/year=eval_year/output/compound_prior_root/retro_root=config.data.retro_root/race_start_target_lap/max_rounds/db_path/db_root) identical; assembly {key:manifest} input-order. LOSO: _iter_loso_units is single source of order (sorted heldout outer, module inner) shared by builder AND consumer; train/backtest args identical (no retro_root); assembly via zip(units,results). CALIB: module-outer, train_years=fit_train_years/eval_year=fit_prediction_years[-1], templates per prediction_year in order. run_jobs guarantees input-order results (utilization.py L266 results[index], L9-12 docstring). cmd_backtest is duck-typed (getattr) so argparse.Namespace->SimpleNamespace is transparent.

q-calibration.title: Calibration equivalence (scrutinize)
q-calibration.imperative: Original looped for prediction_year in fit_prediction_years emitting one row/year. Confirm calibration_fit_split yields exactly ONE fit_prediction_year, OR all years carried. If len can be >1 and only one carried -> BLOCK.
q-calibration.finding: DECISIVE: calibration_fit_split (calibration.py L69-85) returns fit_prediction_years as EITHER [] (len(fit_years)<2) OR [fit_years[-1]] (single element) -- structurally impossible to be len>1. AND the new builder carries ALL prediction years: templates=tuple(SimpleNamespace(...) for prediction_year in fit_prediction_years), so even a hypothetical len>1 would emit all rows. Guard identical (fit_method!=blocked_train_year_split or not fit_train_years or not fit_prediction_years -> []). Row order: result(module)-outer x backtest_outputs(year)-inner == original. NO silent output change. Test test_build_calibration_jobs_module_outer_n_backtests confirms eval_year=2023, one template.

q-report-assembly.title: Report assembly unchanged
q-report-assembly.imperative: Extracted _finalize_and_write_reports preserves report assembly (no reordered/dropped fields). Record pass/fail.
q-report-assembly.finding: _finalize_and_write_reports (runner.py L657-686) is byte-identical to HEAD inline tail: validate(summary,details,calibration) same order, write_markdown_schema, _write_json(summary,details,calibration) same order, write_minimal_markdown_report, shutil.copy2(sampled_manifest), return dict with SAME 7 keys SAME order SAME values. _assemble_report_dicts unchanged and still called before finalize. Pure extraction, no field reordered/dropped.

q-picklable.title: Worker module-level + picklable jobs
q-picklable.imperative: Worker fns module-level; jobs carry only picklable primitives/paths (no DB handles, no tensors). Record pass/fail.
q-picklable.finding: run_train_backtest is module-level in parallel_jobs.py (L45); init_worker/worker fns module-level in utilization.py. TrainBacktestJob is @dataclass(frozen=True) carrying train_args (Namespace of scalars/lists), backtest_templates (tuple of Namespaces WITHOUT bundle), key (str) -- no DatabaseManager, no tensor. Worker lazy-imports cmd_train/cmd_backtest inside the fn (L56-59) to avoid heavy/circular import at pickle time; returns only {key:str, manifest_path:str, backtest_outputs:list[str]}. Test test_train_backtest_job_is_frozen_and_picklable does pickle round-trip + asserts frozen + templates omit bundle.

q-background-inproc.title: Background path is in-process
q-background-inproc.imperative: background (1 worker) takes in-process branch (no ProcessPoolExecutor constructed); confirm via guard test. Record pass/fail.
q-background-inproc.finding: run_jobs (utilization.py L319): if plan.n_workers<=1 return _run_in_process (sequential loop, no ProcessPoolExecutor, no pickling). background plan resolves n_workers=1 (_LEVEL_PLANS L42). Guard test test_background_plan_runs_loso_in_process_without_pool patches src.utils.utilization.ProcessPoolExecutor with side_effect=AssertionError and runs _collect_loso_fusion_train_rows at background -> passes (pool never constructed). All unit tests run at utilization=background.

q-logging.title: Progress logging coherent under concurrency
q-logging.imperative: on_complete completed-count + wall-clock ETA; final summary line preserved; logging not print. Record pass/fail.
q-logging.finding: No print() added (grep: 0). Library logging via logging.getLogger(__name__) (_logger, _evidence_eval_logger). on_complete callbacks (_make_eta_on_complete runner.py, _make_loso_on_complete runner_support.py) log completed-count + wall-clock ETA, invoked in completion order in parent (run_jobs L289-290). 'LOSO fusion: starting' and 'LOSO fusion complete - N rows' summary lines preserved. Dropped per-run-seconds and pre-dispatch per-module progress sub-lines (incompatible with fan-out) -- logging detail only, no output change.

q-simplification.title: Simplification: no NEW violation
q-simplification.imperative: Re-run simplification_limits --paths. parallel_jobs.py + runner.py pass; only failure is pre-existing untouched _gold_preflight_coverage. BLOCK on any NEW violation. Record pass/fail.
q-simplification.finding: Re-ran py -m src.utils.simplification_limits --paths parallel_jobs.py runner.py runner_support.py: FAIL with EXACTLY 2 violations, BOTH on _gold_preflight_coverage (CC=21 limit<20, lines=114 limit<100). parallel_jobs.py PASS, runner.py PASS, runner_support.py's only failures are the pre-existing untouched fn. git diff HEAD shows ZERO change to _gold_preflight_coverage. _collect_loso_fusion_train_rows now UNDER limits (not reported; was CC=20/135) -- net improvement via _iter_loso_units/_parse_loso_event_rows/_make_loso_on_complete extraction. NO NEW violation introduced.

consolidation.summary: G3 parallelization is byte-identical by construction across all 3 loops (main/LOSO/calibration); calibration_fit_split structurally yields a single prediction year AND the builder carries all years; _finalize_and_write_reports is a pure extraction; background path is in-process (guard test passes); no print/no non-picklable data; 40 tests pass; no NEW simplification violation (only pre-existing untouched _gold_preflight_coverage).
